title: Ring Neighbors Alert Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ring:neighbor distance_m=*
| stats sum(distance_m) as total_value, avg(distance_m) as avg_value by alert_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks alert type values by total and average distance across Ring Neighbors alert events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_m` values for each Ring Neighbors alert event and review total and average distance by alert type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total distance.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which alert type shows the biggest distance numbers in your Ring Neighbors alert data.
